title: QuickBooks Online and the Customer Invoice report show the same line text
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a test location whose QuickBooks Online connection is active, linked to a QuickBooks sandbox company you can sign in to.
  • Make sure Require Tech Story is on (Settings, then the Work Orders tab).
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with one labor line, line 1, titled "Replace tie rod" with the description "excessive play".
  • Have line 1 completed with the tech story "Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned", and work order 1 completed and invoiced today as invoice A, which reaches the QuickBooks sandbox.
  • Write down invoice A's number.
  • Use Google Sheets (File, then Import, then Upload) to open downloaded files, so accented letters and character counts read correctly.
  • Keep the QuickBooks sandbox company open in a second browser tab.
  • Start on Reports, then Export Reports in the Reports left menu, with the Export Report dialog open.
custom_steps:
1. In the QuickBooks tab, search for invoice A's number.
  2. Open invoice A.
  3. Switch to the ShopView tab.
  4. Pick Customer Invoice in the Report Name list.
  5. Set the date range to today.
  6. Click Download.
  7. Open the downloaded file in Google Sheets.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • QuickBooks lists invoice A (work order 1's invoice) for its customer.

Step 2:

  • Invoice A opens.
  • Line 1's Description in QuickBooks reads exactly "Replace tie rod - excessive play - Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned".
  • It has no field names and no semicolon.

Step 3:

  • The Export Report dialog is open in ShopView.

Step 4:

  • Customer Invoice is picked in Report Name.

Step 5:

  • The date range shows today's date.

Step 6:

  • A Customer Invoice file downloads.

Step 7:

  • In line 1's row (work order 1's invoice A) the ItemDescription cell reads exactly "Replace tie rod - excessive play - Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned".
  • It is identical, character for character, to line 1's Description in QuickBooks in step 2.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 16 (27 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks)

  • S3-R4: “The same text is used by the live QuickBooks sync and by the downloadable Customer Invoice report. Built at the same moment, the two never show different text for the same line, apart from the leading apostrophe the report adds in S3-R8a. An invoice already in QuickBooks keeps its old text there (S3-N1, S3-E4).”
  • S3-R1: “A line's text joins the title, the description and the technician's narrative with a spaced hyphen and no labels: "Replace tie rod - excessive play - Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned".”
  • Feature Overview, Core functionality: “That text is built in one place and is used by both routes into QuickBooks: the live QuickBooks Online sync, and the downloadable Customer Invoice report. One change fixes both, and the two can never drift apart.”
  • Story 3, Prerequisites: “An invoice's line text is being produced, either by the live QuickBooks sync or by the downloadable Customer Invoice report.”
  • Story 3, Prerequisites: “The live sync needs no user permission of its own. It runs automatically when an invoice is created, for a shop whose QuickBooks connection is active.”
  • Key Decisions: “One builder serves both routes, and it stays that way. The live sync and the downloadable report read the same built line text. Fixing one place fixes both, and it is why the two routes cannot disagree about what a line says. Rejected: changing the report only, which was the original scope and would have left every live-integration shop, the population who actually complained, unfixed.”

Not yet checked against a build by us: the QA build (sv10130.qa.shopview.com, QuickBooks host qb1.qa.shopview.com) and staging carry this change, and this case has not been run on either.
